title: Subway Delay
teaser: Signal problems at DeKalb. The whole line is down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Signal problems at DeKalb. The whole line is down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The platform fills up fast. Someone has a podcast on too loud. Someone else is eating a full meal out of a Tupperware container. Respect.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The MTA app says 'delays expected.' The MTA app always says delays expected.

choices.label: Wait it out
Uber it
Walk and show up late

title: Rent Increase Notice
teaser: There's an envelope under your door. You don't open envelopes anymore.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's an envelope under your door. You don't open envelopes anymore — nothing good comes in an envelope.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You open it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your landlord is raising the rent by $75 a month, effective in 30 days, in compliance with all applicable regulations, he hopes this finds you well.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It does not find you well.

choices.label: Accept and adjust the budget
Write a polite letter asking to negotiate

effects.log: Sent a polite letter to the landlord. He will not respond.

choices.label: Start looking for a new place

title: Roach in the Kitchen
teaser: It's 11pm. You went to get a glass of water. You turned on the kitchen light.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It's 11pm. You went to get a glass of water. You turned on the kitchen light.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You both froze.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It's a big one. Bold. It doesn't even run. It just looks at you with the energy of someone who has been here much longer than you and plans to stay.

choices.label: Buy traps and handle it yourself
Call the super (he won't come for two weeks)
Accept it. Name it Gerald.

title: Bodega Cat Encounter
teaser: You stopped in to grab something for dinner. Then you saw the cat.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You stopped in to grab something for dinner. The usual.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then you saw the cat.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It was sitting on top of the chip display like it owned the place, which it did, which it does, which is correct. It looked at you once, decided you were acceptable, and went back to sleep.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You stood there for longer than you meant to. Something loosened in your chest. A little.

choices.label: Pet the cat and linger
Take a photo and keep moving
Buy something you didn't need just to stay longer

title: Street Festival
teaser: Your block is closed. There's a stage at one end, a row of vendor tables at the other.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your block is closed. There's a stage at one end, a row of vendor tables at the other, and somewhere in the middle a man is doing something with a steel drum that sounds like pure sunlight.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You did not plan for this.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You didn't have plans anyway.

choices.label: Stay and wander the festival
Buy something from a vendor
Find a way around the block closure and keep going

title: Con Edison Spike
teaser: You opened the Con Edison app because you had a bad feeling.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You opened the Con Edison app because you had a bad feeling.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bad feeling was correct.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your bill this month is $214. It was $89 last month. The only thing that changed is the temperature, which Con Edison did not cause but has absolutely monetised.

choices.label: Pay it and move on
Investigate and dispute a charge

effects.log: Filed a dispute. Con Ed will not care.

choices.label: Stop using the AC entirely

title: Noise Complaint Filed Against You
teaser: There's a notice from building management. Apparently a neighbor filed a noise complaint.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's a notice from building management. Apparently a neighbor filed a noise complaint.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Against you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You weren't even doing anything. You were watching TV. At a reasonable volume. At 9:30 in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: New York is full of people who moved here and immediately started complaining about the noise.

choices.label: Apologise and keep it down
File a counter-complaint about THEIR noise
Ignore it completely

title: Street Art Appears Overnight
teaser: Someone put a mural on the side of the laundromat. Overnight. The whole wall.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Someone put a mural on the side of the laundromat. Overnight. The whole wall.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It's a portrait of an older woman with grocery bags, caught mid-stride, looking somewhere just past the frame like she knows exactly where she's going and has always known.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You stand in front of it for a while. You don't know her, but you feel like you might.

choices.label: Take it in and carry it with you
Post it. Share the feeling.
Look up the artist

title: Free Concert in the Park
teaser: The Parks Department sent a notification. There's a free concert this evening.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Parks Department sent a notification. There's a free concert this evening. Jazz quartet. Bring a blanket.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You have a blanket. You have nowhere else to be. The city is, unexpectedly, offering you something for free.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: This happens sometimes. Not often. But sometimes.

choices.label: Go. Bring the blanket.
Go for an hour and then leave
Skip it. You're tired.

title: NYPD Block Closure
teaser: Your usual route is blocked. Six police cars. Caution tape.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your usual route is blocked. Six police cars. Caution tape. An officer is waving everyone around without explanation, which is very on-brand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: People are filming. Some are trying to ask what happened. The officer's face says he has been asked this thirty times and has no interest in being asked a thirty-first.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You take the long way.

choices.label: Take the long way, observe nothing
Ask someone nearby what happened
Film it and post it

title: Scaffolding Goes Up
teaser: You woke up to the sound of drilling.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You woke up to the sound of drilling.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Workers are installing scaffolding outside your window. They told the building it would take six weeks. It will take eight months. This is how scaffolding works in New York.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your window now looks into a steel pipe grid. Beyond the grid: a worker eating a sandwich and looking directly into your apartment.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wave. He waves back. This is your life now.

choices.label: Accept it — this is New York
Buy blackout curtains
Complain to the building

title: Heat Wave
teaser: It's 97 degrees. The humidity has a texture.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It's 97 degrees. The humidity has a texture. The subway smells like the inside of a gym bag that was left in a hot car.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your apartment does not have central air. Your window unit is doing its best. Its best is not enough.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The city has opened a cooling center three blocks away. You are 31 years old. You are considering going to a cooling center.

choices.label: Go to the cooling center — no shame
Survive on iced coffee and denial
Work from a cafe with AC all day

title: Snowstorm
teaser: The forecast said two to four inches. The sky did not read the forecast.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forecast said two to four inches. The sky did not read the forecast.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It is eight inches and still going. The buses are running twenty minutes apart. Everything above 14th Street has a resigned quiet to it — the city, for once, slowing down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You could work from home. You could also just... look out the window for a while.

choices.label: Work from home — no commute, full productivity
Go in anyway — show your face
Take a personal day and walk around in the snow

title: Free Pizza at the Office
teaser: There's a 'team lunch' today. Someone senior felt generous, or guilty, or both.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's a 'team lunch' today. Someone senior felt generous, or guilty, or both.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There are eight pizzas from a place that is either very good or very overhyped — the office is divided. You don't care. It's free pizza.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There is also, somehow, a salad that nobody asked for and nobody will eat.

choices.label: Eat two slices and get back to work
Eat your fill and take a slice for the road
Use the lunch to have a real conversation with a coworker

title: Landlord Sells the Building
teaser: A letter this time, not a slip under the door. Formal. Letterhead.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A letter this time, not a slip under the door. Formal. Letterhead.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your building has been sold to a property management company. Your lease will be honoured. The new owners look forward to a positive relationship with their tenants.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The new owners have a website. The website has a tab called 'Tenant Resources' that leads to a PDF from 2019.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the letter three times. You don't feel good about this.

choices.label: Do nothing and see what happens
Research the property management company
Start quietly looking for other apartments

title: Tourist Asks for Directions
teaser: A couple with matching luggage and a confused energy stops you on the sidewalk.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A couple with matching luggage and a confused energy stops you on the sidewalk. They're trying to get to the High Line.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You know where the High Line is. More importantly, you know they're going to get on the wrong train if you just point them toward the station.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: This will take thirty seconds or three minutes depending on how you play it.

choices.label: Give them full directions, patiently
Point them generally in the right direction and keep walking
Give directions and recommend your favourite spot nearby

title: Power Outage
teaser: The apartment goes dark at 8:47pm. Not just your apartment — the whole block.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The apartment goes dark at 8:47pm. Not just your apartment — the whole block. Maybe further.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You stand very still for a moment. Your phone says 34% battery. Your fridge is going to be fine for four hours. The candle you bought for aesthetics is now functional.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It's quiet in a way that the city almost never is.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Con Ed's outage map shows your area as a 'known issue.' Estimated restoration: unknown.

choices.label: Read by candlelight. Lean into it.
Go find somewhere with power (bar, 24-hour diner)
Go to sleep early

title: Neighbour Brings You Food
teaser: There's a knock at the door. Your downstairs neighbour is standing in the hall with a covered plate.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's a knock at the door. Your downstairs neighbour — you know her as the one who always has something cooking that smells incredible — is standing in the hall with a covered plate.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: She made too much. She always makes too much. Would you like some? It's nothing. It's oxtail and rice and peas and she has been cooking since eleven this morning.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You absolutely would like some.

choices.label: Accept gratefully and thank her properly
Accept and bring her something back later this week
Decline politely — you already ate

title: Rat on the Platform
teaser: There's a rat on the platform. A good one.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's a rat on the platform. A good one. Large, confident, carrying half a hot dog bun with both front paws.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It moves along the yellow safety line with the energy of someone who has a meeting to get to.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tourists are horrified. A kid is delighted. You feel a specific New York emotion that has no name: pride, disgust, recognition, and affection, all at once.

choices.label: Film it — he deserves to be seen
Watch in companionable silence until your train comes
Move to the other end of the platform

title: Surprise Package Delivery
teaser: There's a package outside your door. You didn't order anything.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's a package outside your door. You didn't order anything.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The label has your address but the wrong name. Someone with a similar apartment number two buildings over has your coffee maker, and you have their — you open the box — air fryer.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A very good air fryer. Still in its original packaging.

choices.label: Track down the real owner and return it
Keep it — finder's fee
Leave it in the lobby with a note
